rule: Final rule (owner brief, Oct 24, 2026): a photo is shown only when its reuse basis is documented for that specific file (federal public domain, CC0, Creative Commons with attribution, a VRT permission ticket, or a California state or local government work under Commons' PD-CAGov reading, which rests on County of Santa Clara v. Superior Court (2009)). Legislature portraits, where that reading does not apply, were removed. Identity must be matched by more than name.
searched: The 190 original candidates were searched on Wikidata/Wikimedia Commons on Oct 24, 2026 through the Claude desktop browser; the 39 candidates in the 20 contests added later that day were searched on Wikidata by name, keeping only items whose description names a politician. A search that finds nothing does not mean no photo exists. The 996 local candidates added on Oct 24, 2026 were not searched one by one. 121 of them who hold or held public office, or run for mayor or supervisor, were searched on Wikidata by name in the Claude desktop browser; only items whose description names a matching office or place were considered. Three images were found and none was used (see each record).
